title: Multi-Site Visibility
headline: See every site without calling every manager.
subhead: Live progress, stage signoffs, and automated reporting across your company.
description: Stop chasing site managers on the phone for answers that a report should already give you.
bulletPoints: Money in, money out: A live monthly view of revenue against expenses across all projects.
7 built-in reports: Annual financials, payroll register, vendor procurement, contractor advances, capital & debt, site expense statements, and client statements in PDF and Excel.
Site performance: 10-stage checklist completion and 30-day attendance patterns for every site.
Funds and receivables: Know what is in hand, and what clients still owe site-by-site.
